verdict.rationale: Calendly Workflows automate pre- and post-meeting emails and texts (calendly-docs-12), and reminder emails can be scheduled in one click (calendly-docs-13). Webhooks fire when invitees schedule, cancel, or reschedule (calendly-docs-54). All of this is triggered by individual meetings, not a true recurring job or workflow schedule. missing for 10: time-based or cron-style recurring job scheduling, recurring workflows not tied to bookings, API/MCP control of workflow schedules, independent corroboration.
